phase: Reference Mode Recovery — Government Interest Burden
purpose: Test whether Eurostat publishes a definitionally explicit quarterly observed series for Romania general-government interest expenditure that can serve as the government_interest_burden reference mode without being confused with an effective interest rate, cash interest paid, marginal sovereign yield, or a refinancing parameter.

source.dataset: gov_10q_ggnfa — Quarterly non-financial accounts for general government

promotion_rule: The reference mode may be promoted from SOURCE_IDENTIFIED_NOT_MATERIALIZED to OBSERVED_SERIES_AVAILABLE only after an immutable successful audit artifact is retained, both MIO_NAC and PC_GDP contain all four 2025 quarters with finite observations, each requested unit has at least the minimum observation count, no network or parse error is present, and a repository assessment records the workflow run, artifact identifier and SHA-256. Promotion changes only reference-mode observability; it does not activate any behavioural mechanism or validate the government refinancing/effective-rate mechanism.
negative_result_rule: If the exact D41PAY series is unavailable, incomplete at the required benchmark window, or cannot be retained reproducibly, government_interest_burden remains SOURCE_IDENTIFIED_NOT_MATERIALIZED and no proxy may be substituted silently.
